source.role: binary distance encoding of Hamiltonian Cycle

sourceBasis.step: Replace every undirected edge by two opposite arcs. The degree constraints take linear size and the binary distance increment takes O(log n) gates per arc, giving a CNF of near-linear bit length in the graph size. A fixed power saving for SAT then gives a fixed power saving for Hamiltonian Cycle.
